notes: Protocol version: the PDF (115 pages) holds protocol NN9536-4376 version 2.0 (Final, 21 December 2017; PDF pages 3-96, printed 1-94), Attachment I/II placeholder (p97), Local Protocol Amendment no 1 for Sweden (p98-100), Protocol Amendment no 2 (04 June 2018, to version 2; p101-107) and Protocol Amendment no 3 (04 September 2019, to version 3.0 dated 06 June 2018; p108-115). Version 3.0 itself is not in the PDF. The SoA (flowchart, PDF pages 10-13) and its notes come from version 2.0, so extraction is from version 2.0. Amendment changes relevant to SoA activities/categories: (1) Amendment 3 §2.2 Flowchart: X added at V25 for 'Concomitant medication' and X deleted at V2 for 'Criteria for discontinuation' (p110); (2) Amendment 3 removed WRSSM total score from confirmatory and supportive secondary endpoints and added it as an exploratory endpoint (p110-111; strike-through/italics read from page images) - recorded as a second WRSSM instrument entry; (3) Amendment 2 §2.9 changed the antihypertensive/lipid-lowering treatment evaluation to 'from week 0 until week 24 and from week 24 until end of treatment visit (week 68)' (p106; relevant to 'Evaluation of lipid-lowering treatment' and 'Evaluation of antihypertensive treatment'); (4) Amendment 2 §2.7: TEE for diet counselling calculated once at week 0 instead of randomisation (p105); (5) Amendment 2 §2.8 removed discontinuation criterion no. 1 (violation of inclusion/exclusion/run-in/randomisation criteria) (p105); (6) Amendment 2 §2.13 lymphocyte outlier cut-off changed from < 25 to < 0.2 x 10^9/L (p107). Conflict: pregnancy test lab - Appendix 2 says Table 11-2 tests are performed by the central laboratory and Section 9.4.5 says 'Urine pregnancy tests provided by central laboratory', but Table 11-2 note 5 says 'Local urine testing will be standard unless serum testing is required by local regulation or IRB/IEC'; both recorded (panel and two lab_and_purpose entries). Lab-tests table (Appendix 2, Tables 11-1 and 11-2, PDF pages 64-65) checked against the page images: the text layer keeps one analyte per line and the panel assignments match the images. Conditional/other lab tests outside the panels: INR by central laboratory if ALT or AST > 3 UNL (Table 11-2 note 2); total and free T3 and T4 by central lab if TSH out of normal range (note 4); amylase, lipase and calcitonin not collected at week 52 (note 3); local amylase and lipase if acute pancreatitis is suspected (Section 8.1, p35); anti-semaglutide IgE and binding antibodies and tryptase in case of severe hypersensitivity (Section 9.9, p47). No specimen is stated for the panels except urine for pregnancy testing; 'blood sampling' is stated for FPG, fasting serum insulin and free fatty acid (Section 6.4.1). SoA observations: the second 'Clinical Outcome Assessments' header (PHQ-9, C-SSRS) points to Section 9.4.1, whose heading is 'Mental health assessment instruments'. SoA 'Appendix 3' for informed consent points to Appendix 3 Trial governance considerations (informed consent process on p68); the protocol's Appendix 1 is the abbreviation list. SoA rows the text does not describe beyond the cross-reference: 'Tobacco Use' (only SoA note d), 'Hand out ID card' (Section 9 mentions a card with contact details, p37, not called ID card), 'IWRS session', 'First date on trial product', 'Childbearing potential' assessment details beyond Appendix 5. Demography content is given only in SoA note a. Abbreviations: complete Appendix 1 list (PDF pages 61-63, 67 entries) plus hCG and INR defined only in the lab-tests table (p65). Tokens in SoA activity names not in the abbreviation list: 'ID' (Hand out ID card); 'V'/'P' visit labels are defined in the SoA header ('Visit(V), Phone (P)'). CKD-EPI, T3, T4, PR, QRS, QT are used in the text but not defined. The list spells PHQ-9 as 'Patient Health Questionaire-9' and C-SSRS as 'Columbia-Suicide Severity Rating Scale' (SoA: 'Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale'). No recall periods or instrument modes (paper/electronic) are stated for the PRO questionnaires. No page lacks a text layer.
